rows.evidence: java.lang.AssertionError: en/proxy.md row says the header is always removed although .requestHeader sends it: | `Forwarded`, `X-Real-IP`, `X-Forwarded-Port`, `X-Forwarded-Prefix` | Always removed, whatever the trust setting | (runtime part passed first: over TinyHttpd, Proxy.to(url).stripPrefix(true).requestHeader("X-Forwarded-Prefix", "/api") made the backend receive exactly [/api] while the client sent X-Forwarded-Prefix: /evil; the Korean row '신뢰 설정과 상관없이 언제나 뺍니다' has the same gap)
rows.note: The X-Forwarded-* table of proxy.md and en/proxy.md (column 'What the backend receives') says Forwarded, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-Port and X-Forwarded-Prefix are always removed, but only the client's lines are; .requestHeader accepts these four names (they are not managed) and sends them, as FR-PROXY-005 AC-2 requires for X-Forwarded-Prefix.
PURGE and PROPFIND reach the backend unchanged over TinyHttpd, as the page states.
TRACE, trace and origin-form CONNECT get 405 with the documented Allow over TinyHttpd, no backend request.
Transfer-Encoding: gzip, chunked gets 501 over TinyHttpd without a backend request.
Content-Length with Transfer-Encoding gets 400 over TinyHttpd without a backend request.
Chunked body over bodyLimit(10) gets 413; onError receives HttpException 413 caused by BodyTooLargeException, as documented.
Duplicate backend X-A and Set-Cookie lines reach the TinyHttpd client in order with duplicates.
No Content-Type is added over TinyHttpd when the backend sends none.
Backend header byte 0xE9 reaches the TinyHttpd client as 0xC3 0xA9, as the page states.
Two Host lines get 400 over TinyHttpd without a backend request.
TinyHttpd rawHeaders keep received order and case with no synthetic lines; headerNames lowercase in first-seen order.
available() is not consumption: repeated bodyStream() returns the same object.
A skip that advanced makes a further bodyStream() throw BodyAlreadyConsumedException.
form() and parts() on a JSON request leave the body; bodyStream() returns it whole.
Chunked body over bodyStream(10): 10 bytes read, then BodyTooLargeException with limit() 10.

constraints.C-005: holds: every public method of Proxy and ProxyException and the raw request API (bodyStream, headerNames, rawHeaders, isFromTrustedProxy, rawBodyLimit) is documented in docs/api ko and en with the Express counterpart and Java and Kotlin examples; NaruServe-proxy runtimeClasspath is NaruServe-api only, as the pages state.
